mission: Connect the historical corpus across eras so MathTeach can explain proofs, equations, transmission, domains, and applications as long arcs rather than isolated facts.
networking_principles: Every cross-epoch line must use anchors that are historically attributable and already present in the corpus.
Proof lines explain why a result became believable, reusable, and later reformulated.
Equation lines separate origin, notation change, standardization, and modern reuse.
Transmission paths treat commentary, translation, and pedagogy as first-class mathematical events.
Domain lines should show continuity across eras without pretending that later categories existed unchanged in earlier periods.
Application bridges should end in a present-day teaching value, not just a historical slogan.

proof_lines.title: Exhaustion to integration
proof_lines.throughline: How area and volume proofs moved from classical exhaustion to infinitesimals, limit language, and measure-based integration.

anchors.label: Archimedes: On the Sphere and Cylinder
anchors.contribution: Classical exhaustion and comparison arguments for area and volume.

anchors.label: Archimedes: The Method
anchors.contribution: Heuristic slicing and balance reasoning that anticipates later integral thinking.

anchors.label: Cavalieri: Geometria indivisibilibus continuorum nova quadam ratione promota
anchors.contribution: Indivisibles become a reusable procedure for quadrature and volume arguments.

anchors.label: Wallis: Arithmetica infinitorum
anchors.contribution: Algebraizes infinitesimal summation and extends area methods to symbolic power rules.

anchors.label: Barrow: Lectiones geometricae
anchors.contribution: Links tangent and area reasoning in a form directly adjacent to calculus.

anchors.label: Cauchy: Cours d'analyse de l'Ecole Royale Polytechnique
anchors.contribution: Rebuilds infinitesimal reasoning through limit-based proof standards.

anchors.label: Lebesgue: Integrale, longueur, aire
anchors.contribution: Generalizes integration through measure and completes a long proof tradition about area.

proof_lines.learner_value: Lets the tutor explain integrals as a centuries-long proof tradition instead of a sudden school formula.

proof_lines.title: Equation solvability to abstract structure
proof_lines.throughline: How solving equations moved from explicit procedures to proofs about what cannot be solved and why structure matters.

anchors.label: Diophantus: Arithmetica
anchors.contribution: Models algebraic problem solving as families of equation tasks.

anchors.label: Al-Khwarizmi: Al-jabr
anchors.contribution: Turns equation solving into named procedures and canonical cases.

anchors.label: Omar Khayyam: Demonstration concerning problems of algebra
anchors.contribution: Extends solvability to cubic equations through geometric construction.

anchors.label: Viete: In artem analyticam isagoge
anchors.contribution: Creates symbolic language for general equation manipulation.

anchors.label: Abel: Memoire sur les equations algebriques, ou l'on demontre l'impossibilite de la resolution de l'equation generale du cinquieme degre
anchors.contribution: Proves that the general quintic cannot be solved by radicals.

anchors.label: Galois: Memoire sur les conditions de resolubilite des equations par radicaux
anchors.contribution: Explains solvability through group structure rather than formulas alone.

anchors.label: Emmy Noether: Idealtheorie in Ringbereichen
anchors.contribution: Shifts algebra toward structural method beyond individual equation families.

proof_lines.learner_value: Helps explain why modern algebra studies structure, not only techniques for finding roots.

proof_lines.title: Formal proof and its limits
proof_lines.throughline: How proof moved from axiomatic demonstration to formal logic, normalization, incompleteness, and computability limits.

anchors.label: Euclid: Elements
anchors.contribution: Classical model of axioms, propositions, and deductive demonstration.

anchors.label: Hilbert: Grundlagen der Geometrie
anchors.contribution: Recasts geometry as an explicitly axiomatized formal system.

anchors.label: Russell and Whitehead: Principia Mathematica
anchors.contribution: Logicist attempt to rebuild mathematics inside symbolic logic.

anchors.label: Gerhard Gentzen: Untersuchungen ueber das logische Schliessen I and II
anchors.contribution: Studies the internal shape of proofs through natural deduction and normalization.

anchors.label: Godel: Ueber formal unentscheidbare Saetze der Principia Mathematica und verwandter Systeme I
anchors.contribution: Shows that strong formal systems cannot capture all arithmetic truth.

anchors.label: Turing: On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem
anchors.contribution: Connects formal procedure to mechanical computability and undecidability.

proof_lines.learner_value: Makes proof itself teachable as a historical object with strengths, reforms, and hard limits.

equation_lines.title: Quadratic equation line
equation_lines.throughline: How quadratic problems moved from verbal procedures to symbolic generality and modern classroom standard form.

anchors.label: Al-Khwarizmi: Al-jabr
anchors.contribution: Canonical case-based procedures and geometric completion.

anchors.label: Viete: In artem analyticam isagoge
anchors.contribution: General symbolic manipulation of unknowns and coefficients.

anchors.label: Descartes: La Geometrie
anchors.contribution: Places polynomial equations into coordinate geometry and curve analysis.

anchors.label: Cauchy: Cours d'analyse de l'Ecole Royale Polytechnique
anchors.contribution: Stabilizes analytic language around function, equation, and solution behavior.

equation_lines.learner_value: Supports a teaching path from verbal recipe to symbolic formula to graph-based interpretation.

equation_lines.title: Differential and integral notation
equation_lines.throughline: How change and accumulation gained a stable notation that outlived the first intuitions behind calculus.

anchors.label: Nicole Oresme: Tractatus de configurationibus qualitatum et motuum
anchors.contribution: Prefigures graphing and the representation of changing quantities.

anchors.label: Newton: Method of Fluxions
anchors.contribution: Introduces fluxional notation and variable change as motion.

anchors.label: Leibniz: Nova Methodus pro Maximis et Minimis
anchors.contribution: Introduces differential notation and the integral sign lineage.

anchors.label: Cauchy: Cours d'analyse de l'Ecole Royale Polytechnique
anchors.contribution: Reinterprets calculus notation through limit-centered rigor.

anchors.label: Weierstrass: Mathematische Werke
anchors.contribution: Pushes notation toward quantified epsilon-delta expression.

equation_lines.learner_value: Allows the tutor to distinguish between notation, intuition, and later rigor when teaching calculus.

equation_lines.title: Probability language line
equation_lines.throughline: How chance moved from gambling correspondence to expectation, law, and axiomatic event language.

anchors.label: Pascal and Fermat correspondence on games of chance
anchors.contribution: Turns chance problems into countable mathematical cases.

anchors.label: Huygens: De Ratiociniis in Ludo Aleae
anchors.contribution: Systematizes expectation and reusable rules for games of chance.

anchors.label: Jacob Bernoulli: Ars Conjectandi
anchors.contribution: Extends chance into law-like reasoning and long-run frequency.

anchors.label: Kolmogorov: Grundbegriffe der Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung
anchors.contribution: Recasts probability through events, sigma-algebras, and measure.

anchors.label: John von Neumann and Oskar Morgenstern: Theory of Games and Economic Behavior
anchors.contribution: Pushes probabilistic language into strategy, equilibrium, and decision.

equation_lines.learner_value: Shows that modern probability notation grew from concrete chance problems rather than appearing fully formed.

equation_lines.title: Infinity and set language
equation_lines.throughline: How mathematical language for number, infinity, and collection became explicit and axiomatized.

anchors.label: Archimedes: The Method
anchors.contribution: Treats the infinite heuristically while keeping proof demands in view.

anchors.label: Dedekind: Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?
anchors.contribution: Reconstructs number through set-theoretic and structural language.

anchors.label: Cantor: Beitrage zur Begrundung der transfiniten Mengenlehre
anchors.contribution: Makes transfinite size and cardinal comparison explicit.

anchors.label: Zermelo: Untersuchungen ueber die Grundlagen der Mengenlehre I
anchors.contribution: Stabilizes set language through axioms and controlled formation rules.

anchors.label: Nicolas Bourbaki: Elements of Mathematics (Theory of Sets)
anchors.contribution: Makes structural set language a common platform for modern exposition.

equation_lines.learner_value: Supports lessons that separate intuitive infinity, formal infinity, and axiomatized set language.

transmission_paths.title: Euclid commentary and transmission path
transmission_paths.throughline: How Euclidean geometry survived and changed through commentary, teaching, and reaxiomatization.

anchors.label: Euclid: Elements
anchors.contribution: Origin text of axiomatic geometry.

anchors.label: Theon of Alexandria: Euclid and Ptolemy commentary tradition
anchors.contribution: Late-antique editorial and explanatory route for Euclidean geometry.

anchors.label: Hypatia: commentary tradition on Arithmetica and Conics
anchors.contribution: Shows commentary as active mathematical continuation, not passive preservation.

anchors.label: Adelard of Bath: Euclid translation tradition
anchors.contribution: Carries Euclidean geometry into the Latin teaching world.

anchors.label: Hilbert: Grundlagen der Geometrie
anchors.contribution: Reopens Euclid through formal independence and modern axiomatics.

transmission_paths.title: Hindu-Arabic number transmission path

anchors.label: Aryabhata: Aryabhatiya
anchors.contribution: Represents an early high-level Indian computational and astronomical tradition.

anchors.label: Brahmasphutasiddhanta
anchors.contribution: Articulates arithmetic with zero and signed quantity rules.

anchors.label: Al-Khwarizmi: Book on Addition and Subtraction after the Method of the Indians
anchors.contribution: Explicitly transmits Indian numeration into Arabic mathematical practice.

anchors.label: Fibonacci: Liber Abaci
anchors.contribution: Introduces the numeral system into Latin European commerce and calculation.

anchors.label: Stevin: De Thiende
anchors.contribution: Pushes decimal positional thinking into everyday and scientific calculation.

anchors.label: Gauss: Disquisitiones Arithmeticae
anchors.contribution: Shows the fully mature arithmetic culture built on the earlier numeral tradition.

transmission_paths.learner_value: Lets the tutor teach arithmetic as a transmission success across cultures rather than a local invention.

transmission_paths.title: Archimedean method transmission path
transmission_paths.throughline: How Archimedean reasoning moved through commentary and reinvention into calculus and modern analysis.

anchors.label: Archimedes: The Method
anchors.contribution: Source of the slicing and balancing imagination around area and volume.

anchors.label: Eutocius of Ascalon: commentaries on Archimedes and Apollonius
anchors.contribution: Preserves and explains Archimedean technical arguments.

anchors.label: Cavalieri: Geometria indivisibilibus continuorum nova quadam ratione promota
anchors.contribution: Reopens a comparable area-and-volume imagination with indivisibles.

anchors.label: Barrow: Lectiones geometricae
anchors.contribution: Links older geometry to proto-calculus arguments.

anchors.label: Lebesgue: Integrale, longueur, aire

transmission_paths.learner_value: Supports narratives where classical geometry and modern integration belong to one historical family.

build_order: Normalize stable ids for works, figures, proof threads, and equation threads.
Attach cross-epoch anchors to the current chronology corpus without duplicating historical facts.
Write short proof, equation, and transmission summaries for each network line.
Expose network traversal in the API before full database ingestion.
Use the network layer to guide later retrieval, citation, and pedagogy orchestration.
